core.bind.message.auto.confirm.inherit: Data inheritance method: The language follows the initiator. The module toggles, administrator lists, and restriction lists are taken as the union of both sides. Context settings are merged item by item, with the initiator’s entry taking precedence for items with the same name. if module data exists on only one side, it is migrated directly; if it exists on both sides, the system will prompt the user for each item to determine which version to retain. The two contexts will also be marked as belonging to the same message channel: from then on, the same command will be executed by only one of the bots, push notifications will be sent only once, and both sides will record the other’s bot account, no longer parsing messages sent by the other side as commands. The merge cannot be undone.

If you need to use push notification modules or regular expression modules, please contact the group admin to enable the “Access all messages in the group” and “Bot can actively post in the group chat” permissions for the bot.
